arguments.need: I want an AI helper in my terminal that can read my project, edit files and run commands, but I'm tired of tools that drag in Python or Node and a pile of packages. Ideally it's a single small binary I can compile myself with just a C compiler. It has to keep working with no internet by running a model stored on my own machine, and it should ask me before every file change or shell command. Open source is a must.
